raw_segments.text: When Sarah entered the room, Lottie was lying upon the floor, screaming and kicking her
small fat legs violently, and Miss Amelia was bending over her in consternation and
despair, looking quite red and damp with heat.
Lottie had always found, when in her own nursery at home, that kicking and screaming would
always be quieted by any means she insisted on.
Poor plump Miss Amelia was trying first one method, and then another.
